name: Bottle-Cap Blast
oracle_text:
Improvise (Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)
Bottle-Cap Blast deals 5 damage to any target. If excess damage was dealt to a permanent this way, create that many tapped Treasure tokens. (They're artifacts with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
blocked_sentences: If excess damage was dealt to a permanent this way, create that many tapped Treasure tokens.

needs.what: a value reading how much excess damage (120.4a: damage beyond lethal for a creature, beyond loyalty for a planeswalker, beyond defense for a battle) the preceding damage effect dealt to the permanent it hit, bindable (e.g. `as` on the `damage` op, read as {"binding": ...}) so a following create_token amount can be 'that many'; 0 when the target was a player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The damage op's `excess_to` only redirects the remainder to the creature's controller (Gandalf's Sanction) and splits the event; here all 5 damage is dealt to the permanent and the excess is only measured. No value_key reports excess damage, and composing minus/toughness_of/snapshot cannot account for damage already marked, planeswalker loyalty or battle defense, nor zero it for a player target
